name: pando-map-tools
description: Analyze map images, refine georeferencing and boundary candidates, export GeoJSON, and train map models.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze maps and export reviewed GIS data
interface.longDescription: Turn map images into reviewed GeoJSON using local OCR, georeferencing and boundary models. From a phone, use a Codex/Remote conversation connected to the computer that holds the workspace and shared data. Analysis runs on that computer.
defaultPrompt: Map Toolkit으로 첨부한 지도를 분석하고 경계 후보를 GeoJSON으로 만들어줘
Map Toolkit으로 기존 분석 결과를 검토하고 경계를 수정해줘
